race.title: Bet With Ascot Donation Box Winners 'Introductory' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: PUSH THE LIMIT failed to land the odds on his hurdles debut but Dan Skelton's 4-y-o should prove capable of much better given his smart Flat form. Spanish Stroll showed a good turn of foot when scoring on his hurdles bow and is most feared, whilst Without Burlington made a good impression at Worcester in the summer and also merits consideration after a break. PUSH THE LIMIT (FR) SPANISH STROLL WITHOUT BURLINGTON
race.bettingForecast: Push The Limit (13/8), Premiere Ligne (9/4), Spanish Stroll (4/1), Without Burlington (6/1), Prometeo (16/1), Expressionless (25/1)
